source: Derived 2026-10-31 (#418). Classes and skills are the shared Quest ruleset taken from the Star Quest dataset at its GENERIC naming (Army Forge records each class twice: 'Soldier' for Star Quest, 'Fighter' for AoF: Quest - the second is this file's 'name', the first is kept as 'sqName'). Status conditions, injuries and the treasure item names are typed from 'AoFQ - Core Rules v2.0.1.pdf', 'AoFQ - Beginners Guide v2.1.0.pdf' and 'AoFQ - Campaign Builder v2.1.0.pdf' word for word. (2026-11-22: the shop's item list WAS found - Army Forge's Hero Builder reads it from /api/quest/rules/7, 33 consumables with AoF: Quest names and tiers but no costs; 'consumables' now holds it, and QuestItemSkin maps each to its Star Quest twin, whose rules text is word for word the same. Skill wording also refreshed from there.) Previously: the SHOP's item list was thought unavailable. Neither AoF: Quest book prints it (nor does the Star Quest Campaign Builder - Star Quest's 33 consumables came from Army Forge's own quest data, and there is no API endpoint for it), so 'consumables' stays EMPTY rather than guessed. The nine items the Hidden Treasure table can produce ARE known by name and are listed under 'treasureItems'; the engine wires each to the effect of the Star Quest item in the same table slot (QuestItemSkin), which is an inference recorded as one.

notes.whyIdsMatchStarQuest: The class ids are the link between a class and its skills, and between a saved hero and its class. They are deliberately the same values the Star Quest dataset uses, because the two systems share one skill list - a hero's ClassId therefore resolves in either dataset.
notes.rulesGeneration: AoF: Quest is on 2.1.0 core rules, same as Star Quest, confirmed from the v2.1.0 Beginners Guide: 3 power for an extra action and for a revive, an OPTIONAL 1-power payment on a failed hero skill, a flat 3" melee reach, a 9" Scout, and a 6" mandatory Villain aura. The project's AoFQ Core Rules PDF is still the older v2.0.1, which disagreed on all of those - see WorkItems/418.
notes.classFeaturesRenamed2026_11_22: The 12 class features now carry AoF: Quest's own names from Army Forge (/api/quest/rules/7), e.g. Monk's Meditation (Star Quest: Sentinel Meditation); the Star Quest name is kept as sqName. The engine plays them by the Star Quest name through QuestItemSkin.

baseHero.note: Carried over from Star Quest, and now well founded rather than a guess: both systems are on 2.1.0 core rules, which share every hero mechanic this stat line feeds. Neither AoF: Quest book prints a level-1 stat line (the hero's Qua, Def and Tough come from its army-book profile, which IS imported).

skills.rule: Until the end of the round, the next time the Hero destroys an enemy unit by shooting, it may immediately shoot at another enemy unit.

skills.name: Assassination
skills.rule: Until the end of the round, the next time the Hero shoots at an enemy that had no line of sight to the Hero when it activated and deals at least one hit, it deals one extra hit.

skills.name: Conjuration
skills.rule: Until the end of the round, the Hero gets +6" range either when casting its next spell, or the next time it spends tokens to modify enemy casting rolls.

skills.name: Reckless
skills.rule: Until the end of the round, whenever the Hero attacks an enemy in melee or shoots at it from within 12", if it deals at least one wound, then it deals one extra wound, but whenever it takes at least one wound, it takes one extra wound.

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.rule: The Hero may spend X Power (max. 3). Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes X+1 hits with AP(3).

skills.name: Tinkered Luck
skills.rule: Until the end of the round, the next time the Hero fails to cast a spell, or the next time it spends tokens to modify an enemy casting roll and the enemy successfully casts the spell, you may re-roll that casting roll.

consumables.name: Agility Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero automatically passes all jumping rolls until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Curing Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero loses all status conditions. The effect may be applied to one other Hero within 3" instead.

consumables.name: Health Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero restores 3 wounds. The effect may be applied to one other Hero within 3" instead.

consumables.name: Insight Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero may reveal one Search token in line of sight and within 12", and may modify the roll to see what it contains by +1/-1.

consumables.name: Speed Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero gets +2" on Advance, and +4" on Rush/Charge until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Great Health Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero restores 6 wounds. The effect may be applied to one other Hero within 3" instead.

consumables.name: Blinding Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Pick one enemy unit within 9", which gets -1 to hit until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Trueshot Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero gets +6" range until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Noise Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Place one noise marker within 12". Enemies treat the nearest marker as the AI goal. Remove the marker at the end of 3 rounds, or when an enemy moves within 1".

consumables.name: Great Speed Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero gets +4" on Advance, and +8" on Rush/Charge until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Great Mana Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero gets two spell tokens.

consumables.name: Reviving Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Revive one unconscious Hero within 3", and it restores 6 wounds.

consumables.name: Power Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero gets +2 to its next stat roll.

consumables.name: Energy Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero doesn't get fatigued until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Resting Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero restores 3 Power. The effect may be applied to one other Hero within 3" instead.

consumables.name: Phantasm Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Place one phantasm marker within 6". Enemies treat the marker as a Hero. Remove the marker at the end of 3 rounds, or when an enemy attacks or moves within 1" of it.

consumables.name: Teleport Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero may be placed anywhere within 6".

consumables.name: Stunning Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Pick one enemy unit within 6", which must take a morale test. If failed, it is Shaken.

consumables.name: Poison Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Place a poison marker on an enemy unit within 9". When it activates, roll one die. On a 4+ it takes 1 wound, else the marker is removed.

consumables.name: Smoke Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Place a smoke marker within 12". The area within 3" of it counts as Cover Terrain. Remove the marker at the end of 3 rounds.

consumables.name: Fire Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Place a fire marker within 12". The area within 3" of it counts as Dangerous Terrain. Remove the marker at the end of 3 rounds.

consumables.name: Stoneskin Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero gets +1 to Def rolls until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Heroic Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero automatically passes all morale tests until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Thunder Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Pick one enemy unit within 6", which is immediately pushed 6" directly away.

consumables.name: Gunpowder Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Pick one enemy unit within 9" and roll one die. On a 4+ it takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and AP(1).

consumables.name: Grease Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Place a grease marker within 12". The area within 3" of it counts as Difficult Terrain. Remove the marker at the end of 3 rounds.

consumables.name: Web Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Pick one enemy unit within 9", which gets -2" on Advance, and -4" on Rush/Charge until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Silence Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Place a silence marker on an enemy unit within 9". That unit gets -2 to spell casting rolls until the end of the round. Remove the marker at the end of 3 rounds.

consumables.name: Pheromone Bomb
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. Pick one enemy unit within 9", which other enemies treat as a Hero until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Mana Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero gets one spell token.

consumables.name: Conquest Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The next time the Hero destroys an enemy unit until the end of the round, it may move by up to 6".

consumables.name: Great Stoneskin Elixir
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero gets +2 to Def rolls until the end of the round.

consumables.name: Great Resting Potion
consumables.description: Use with Skill action, then remove. The Hero restores 6 Power. The effect may be applied to one other Hero within 3" instead.

injuries.name: Smashed Leg
injuries.description: -2 inches on Advance, and -4 inches on Rush/Charge

conditions.name: Afflicted
conditions.description: When activated, must pass a Str test to remove status. If failed, the model takes 1 wound.

conditions.name: Crippled
conditions.description: When activated, must pass a Dex test to remove status. Crippled models halve their movement distance.

conditions.name: Diseased
conditions.description: When activated, must pass a Wil test to remove status. Diseased models take as many wounds as power they spend.

conditions.name: Impaired
conditions.description: When activated, may spend D3 power to remove status. Impaired models get -1 to all stat rolls.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: Martial artists relying on the power of their own bodies to produce impressive results.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Keepers of arcane secrets and forgotten knowledge, that manipulate spells with cunning.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Stealthy operators that have a knack for picking out enemy weaknesses and exploiting them.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: Relentless combatants that love to get stuck in conflict, fueled by their rage and fury.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: Public speakers and performers using their wits, spells, and lore to overcome difficult situations.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: Warriors that bolster their efforts with steadfast dedication, gaining special boons and strength through devotion.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: Skilled combatants that rely on their heavy armor and weapons to cut down their enemies.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Deadly hunters that use a unique blend of wilderness knowledge and martial abilities.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: Spell casters that draw their powers from within, channeling their innate powers through themselves and their instruments.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Nomads devoted to the powers of the natural world, capable of adopting the form of beasts for battle or utility.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: Dark spell casters which form pacts with powerful entities they trade favors with for boons and spells.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Devotees of their deity, capable of bolstering their party and heal their wounds, or laying low their enemies with divine wrath.

classes.name: Default Skills
classes.description: Here are all the default skills which are available to all classes.

treasureItems.note: The Hidden Treasure table's items, from AoFQ Campaign Builder v2.1.0. Names only - no book prints their effects. The engine maps each to its Star Quest twin in the same table slot (FDG.Quest.QuestItemSkin), so they behave identically and read as fantasy.

currency.note: AoF: Quest counts gold where Star Quest counts credits (Hazard Pay is '5g times the chosen Difficulty level').
